$comment: One-based indexes into each app evidence.json theming.escapeHatchesUsed array. A1/A2 score only offRouteOverrides. The four arrays must be exhaustive and disjoint.

definition.offRouteOverrides: Unsupported/internal overrides or deviations required because the documented route did not meet the evaluated need.
definition.integrationWork: Documented providers, configuration, adapters and composition required to integrate the candidate.
definition.designDecisions: Deliberate product or evaluation choices, limitations recorded without a workaround, and styling owned by the application.
definition.notUsed: Entries explicitly recording that no escape hatch was required.
